title: Dan Billson — browser typewriter: footer as two quiet pill buttons
note: A 19-second looping screen recording of a browser typewriter app: text types itself on an off-white paper sheet over a nature photo, then the sheet vanishes and a fresh blank sheet slides in — you can't fix it and you can't keep it. The footer is two small translucent-white pill buttons pinned to the bottom corners: Sound and New sheet. Her steal: the footer as just two quiet actions in her own type voice, not a sitemap — the opposite pole from the Sedrus footer. Captured date is the drop date; post is Nov 17.
